gloss: whole body; with all one's might

definitions.gloss: whole body, with all one's might, putting everything into
definitions.explanation: Using one's entire body and spirit, pouring all of one's energy and effort into something. Almost always used as a modifier in the pattern {渾身|こんしん}の + noun, describing something done with maximum effort or intensity.

examples.japanese: {渾身|こんしん}の{力|ちから}で{投|な}げた。
examples.english: I threw with all my might.

examples.japanese: {渾身|こんしん}の{一撃|いちげき}を{放|はな}った。
examples.english: He delivered a blow with everything he had.

examples.japanese: この{作品|さくひん}は{作者|さくしゃ}が{渾身|こんしん}の{力|ちから}を{込|こ}めて{書|か}いた{小説|しょうせつ}だ。
examples.english: This work is a novel that the author wrote pouring everything into it.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the pattern {渾身|こんしん}の + noun. Rarely appears on its own. Conveys an intense, dramatic quality — the idea that someone has held nothing back.

Common in sports commentary, literary descriptions, and dramatic narratives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {渾身|こんしん}の{力|ちから}: all one's strength
- {渾身|こんしん}の{一撃|いちげき}: a blow with everything behind it
- {渾身|こんしん}の{力|ちから}を{込|こ}めて: putting all one's strength into
- {渾身|こんしん}の{作|さく}: a work created with full effort
- {渾身|こんしん}の{演技|えんぎ}: a performance given with everything
